jobs.description: How many jobs to run concurrently such as tool installs. Values below 1 are treated as 1.

experimental.description: Enable experimental features, which may change or be removed in any release.

always_keep_download.description: [deprecated] Keep downloaded archives and sources after installing, for debugging.

credential_command.description: Command that prints a GitHub token on stdout.

gh_cli_tokens.description: Read GitHub tokens that the gh CLI stores in its `hosts.yml` file.

github_attestations.description: Verify GitHub artifact attestations for github backend tools.

oauth_api_url.description: GitHub API base URL mise uses to validate native OAuth tokens.

oauth_auth_url.description: GitHub OAuth endpoint base URL for the native device flow.

oauth_cache_get.description: Command that prints the native GitHub OAuth refresh tokens stored by github.oauth_cache_set.

oauth_cache_secure_enclave.description: Keep the native GitHub OAuth refresh token behind Touch ID in the macOS Secure Enclave.

oauth_cache_set.description: Command that stores the native GitHub OAuth refresh tokens, read from its stdin.

oauth_client_id.description: GitHub App client ID that turns on native OAuth device-flow tokens.

oauth_export_env.description: Environment variable that mise exports the native GitHub OAuth token under; empty turns the export off.

oauth_open_browser.description: Open the verification page in your browser during the native GitHub OAuth device flow.

oauth_scopes.description: OAuth scopes requested for native GitHub device-flow tokens.

slsa.description: Verify SLSA provenance for github backend tools that name a signer.

use_git_credentials.description: Get GitHub tokens from your Git credential helpers with `git credential fill`.

corepack.description: Run `corepack enable` after installing a Node.js version, so `yarn` and `pnpm` go through Corepack.

nodenv_root.description: Root directory of nodenv, which `mise sync node --nodenv` imports Node.js versions from.

npm_shim.description: Wrap each Node.js version's `npm` so that `npm install -g` runs `mise reshim` afterwards.

nvm_dir.description: Directory of nvm, which `mise sync node --nvm` imports Node.js versions from.

verify.description: Verify downloaded Node.js archives against the SHA-256 checksums in `SHASUMS256.txt`.
